visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Sidebar has no room
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The page should have a narrow sidebar of 80px and a content area that fills all the rest of the row. The content only takes the width of its text.
visualizerParams.buggyCode:
Menu
Content

solution.code:
Menu
Content
solution.explanation: A flex item keeps its content size unless it is allowed to grow. flex: 1 makes the content area take all the free space that the fixed sidebar leaves.

checks.label: The content fills the rest of the row
